game.name: Street Fighter X Tekken (World)(Beta)(2012-01-15)
game.desc: Street Fighter X Tekken on Xbox 360 is a fighting game based on the engine and gameplay of Super Street Fighter IV. The particularity of this game is to integrate characters from the Tekken franchise. In this crossover, you will find fighters like Ryu, Chun-Li and Zangief, as well as Kazuya Mishima and Nina Williams, redesigned in the style of the SF IV characters.
